27211-jerry-s-charge-account.title: Jerry S Charge Account
27211-jerry-s-charge-account.creator: Hazel Wilson
27211-jerry-s-charge-account.description: A book by Hazel Wilson. Jerry tried to be quiet, but he bumped into the one chair in the kitchen on his way to the kitchen cupboard. And it was not his fault that the cream pitcher fell when he took the sugarbowl from the shelf. Jerry made a quick and nice southpaw catch. Pretty good, he thought, for a right-hander.

4298-the-paying-guest.title: The Paying Guest
4298-the-paying-guest.creator: George Gissing
4298-the-paying-guest.description: A book by George Gissing. Next morning arrived a letter, signed 'Louise E. Derrick.' The writer said she had been waiting to compare and think over some two hundred answers to her advertisement. 'It's really too absurd. How can I remember them all? But I liked yours as soon as I read it, and I am writing to you first of all. Will you let me come and see you? I can tell you about myself much better than writing. Would tomorrow do, in the afternoon?

arxiv-1910-02651.title: Generalized spaces of pointwise regularity: To a general framework for the WLM
arxiv-1910-02651.creator: L. Loosveldt, S. Nicolay
arxiv-1910-02651.description: Abstract In this work we generalize the spaces T u p T^{p}_{u} introduced by Calderón and Zygmund using a pointwise version of conditions defining the generalized Besov spaces and give conditions binding the functions belonging to these spaces and the wavelet coefficients of such functions.

arxiv-2106-10775.title: Covariance Matching based robust Adaptive Cubature Kalman Filter
arxiv-2106-10775.creator: \IEEEauthorblockN Mundla Narasimhappa \IEEEauthorrefmark 1 \IEEEauthorieeemembermark 1 and Sesham Srinu \IEEEauthorrefmark 2 \IEEEauthorblockA \IEEEauthorrefmark 1Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Surrey, Surrey, GU2 7XH, UK \IEEEauthorrefmark 2Department of Electrical Engineering,
arxiv-2106-10775.description: Abstract This letter explores covariance matching based adaptive robust cubature Kalman filter (CMRACKF). In this method, the innovation sequence is used to determine the covariance matrix of measurement noise that can overcome the limitation of conventional CKF. In the proposed algorithm, weights are adaptively adjust and used for updating the measurement noise covariance matrices online.

arxiv-2207-06954.title: Designing the self-assembly of arbitrary shapes using minimal complexity building blocks
arxiv-2207-06954.creator: Joakim Bohlin a,b, Andrew J. Turberfield a,c, Ard A. Louis d, Petr Šulc b,
arxiv-2207-06954.description: Abstract The design space for a self-assembled multicomponent objects ranges from a solution in which every building block is unique to one with the minimum number of distinct building blocks that unambiguously define the target structure. Using a novel pipeline, we explore the design spaces for a set of structures of various sizes and complexities.

arxiv-2403-14281.title: UAV-Assisted Maritime Search and Rescue: A Holistic Approach
arxiv-2403-14281.creator: Martin Messmer, Benjamin Kiefer, Leon Amadeus Varga, Andreas Zell
arxiv-2403-14281.description: Abstract In this paper, we explore the application of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in maritime search and rescue (mSAR) missions, focusing on medium-sized fixed-wing drones and quadcopters. We address the challenges and limitations inherent in operating some of the different classes of UAVs, particularly in search operations.

arxiv-2408-08320.title: Hardware-Algorithm Re-engineering of Retinal Circuit for Intelligent Object Motion Segmentation
arxiv-2408-08320.creator: Jason Sinaga*, Victoria Clerico*, Md Abdullah-Al Kaiser, Shay Snyder, Arya Lohia, Gregory Schwartz, Maryam Parsa, Akhilesh Jaiswal
arxiv-2408-08320.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jason Sinaga*, Victoria Clerico*, Md Abdullah-Al Kaiser, Shay Snyder, Arya Lohia, Gregory Schwartz, Maryam Parsa, Akhilesh Jaiswal. Recent advances in retinal neuroscience have fueled various hardware and algorithmic efforts to develop retina-inspired solutions for computer vision tasks. In this work, we focus on a fundamental visual feature within the mammalian retina, Object Motion Sensitivity (OMS). Using DVS data from EV-IMO dataset, we analyze the performance of an algorithmic implementation of OMS circuitry for motion segmentation in presence of ego-motion.

arxiv-2412-07801.title: Learning to Correction: Explainable Feedback Generation for Visual Commonsense Reasoning Distractor
arxiv-2412-07801.creator: Jiali Chen, Xusen Hei, Yuqi Xue, Yuancheng Wei, Jiayuan Xie, Yi Cai, Qing Li
arxiv-2412-07801.description: Abstract . Large multimodal models (LMMs) have shown remarkable performance in the visual commonsense reasoning (VCR) task, which aims to answer a multiple-choice question based on visual commonsense within an image. However, the ability of LMMs to correct potential visual commonsense errors in the distractor upon their occurrence is yet under-explored.

arxiv-2504-02873.title: Short-PHD: Detecting Short LLM-generated Text with Topological Data Analysis After Off-topic Content Insertion
arxiv-2504-02873.creator: Dongjun Wei, Minjia Mao, Xiao Fang, Michael Chau
arxiv-2504-02873.description: Abstract The malicious usage of large language models (LLMs) has motivated the detection of LLM-generated texts. Previous work in topological data analysis shows that the persistent homology dimension (PHD) of text embeddings can serve as a more robust and promising score than other zero-shot methods. However, effectively detecting short LLM-generated texts remains a challenge.

pmc-10578764.title: Comparing the effectiveness of single-lumen high-frequency positive pressure ventilation with double-lumen endobronchial tube for the anesthesia management of endoscopic thoracic sympathetic blockade surgery
pmc-10578764.creator: İlhan Akaslan, Suna Koc
pmc-10578764.description: Objectives:In this trial, we aimed to compare anesthetic effectiveness of single lumen tube (SLT) for tracheal intubation with high-frequency positive pressure ventilation (HFPPV) versus classic double lumen tube (DLT) for tracheal intubation in endoscopic thoracic sympathetic blockade surgery.Design:This was a prospective randomized controlled clinical study.Setting:The study was single-centered and conducted in a university hospital.

pmc-11347242.title: Factors associated with lifetime use of commercial sex work services among Japanese men aged 20–49: findings from a quasi-representative national survey, 2022
pmc-11347242.creator: Cyrus Ghaznavi, Peter Ueda, Shuhei Nomura, Masahiro Ishikane, Shunsuke Uno, Haruka Sakamoto
pmc-11347242.description: ObjectivesApproximately half of Japanese men aged 20–49 years have purchased sexual services, but data concerning the use of commercial sex work (CSW) in Japan remain scarce.MethodsWe used online survey data from the National Inventory of Japanese Sexual Behavior conducted in 2022 (N=4000 Japanese men aged 20–49 years). We calculated the median number of paid sexual partners over the lifetime.

pmc-11529554.title: The impact of short video usage on the mental health of elderly people
pmc-11529554.creator: Rui Zhang, Yiming Su, Zheyu Lin, Xiaodan Hu
pmc-11529554.description: BackgroundIn the context of a gradual increase in aging, improving the mental health of the elderly is particularly vital for coping with aging. Leveraging data from the 2020 China Family Panel Studies, this study rigorously examines the influence of short video on the mental health of the elderly.

pmc-11678038.title: Subclinical Detection of Hydroxychloroquine-Induced Retinopathy in Patients with Systemic Lupus Erythematous Using Multifocal Electroretinography and Optical Coherence Tomography
pmc-11678038.creator: Suk Hoon Jung, Young-Hoon Park, Young Gun Park
pmc-11678038.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objectives: Although hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) is used to treat systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), it is associated with retinal toxicity. Early diagnosis can prevent the further progression of HCQ-associated retinopathy by discontinuing HCQ treatments. This study aimed to evaluate the early diagnostic parameters in patients with SLE treated with HCQ and identify the best approach using multifocal electroretinography (mfERG) and swept-source optical coherence tomography (SS-OCT) to reflect subclinical retinal toxicity.

pmc-11689957.title: INTENSIVE GRANDCHILD CARE AND SUCCESSFUL AGING: THE ROLE OF INTERNAL MIGRATION IN CHINA
pmc-11689957.creator: Yue Hu, Helene H Fung, Neil Charness, Jason Wong, Yiqi Wang
pmc-11689957.description: Around two thirds of adults aged 60 years or above are providing grandchild care in China, some of whom even migrate to where their adult children live to provide grandchild care. However, it still remains unclear whether and how grandchild care provision impacts successful aging among migrant or non-migrant grandparents.

pmc-12366297.title: Association of lung ultrasound score with 72-hour intubation needs in pneumonia patients presenting to the emergency department
pmc-12366297.creator: Tanyaporn Nakornchai, Apichaya Monsomboon, Panrada Pathomkajonkul, Ronnapop Jaluspikultip, Rathachai Kaewlai, Nattakarn Praphruetkit, Tipa Chakorn, Sattha Riyapan, Usapan Surabenjawong, Wansiri Chaisirin, Netiporn Thirawattanasoot
pmc-12366297.description: BackgroundThe lung ultrasound (LUS) score is a semi-quantitative tool used to predict clinical outcomes in conditions such as congestive heart failure and acute respiratory distress syndrome. However, its role in pneumonia remains unclear. This study aimed to determine whether the LUS score is associated with the need for intubation within 72 h of emergency department (ED) presentation.

pmc-12464175.title: Optimization of electromagnetic forming process parameters for curved specimens based on CCD-RSM
pmc-12464175.creator: Jie Tang, Mingcai Li, Tao Wang
pmc-12464175.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Electromagnetic forming is an efficient, non-contact high-speed forming technology widely used in aerospace, automotive manufacturing, and other industries. This paper introduces a novel curved workpiece based on an elliptical coil, with characteristics similar to rocket propellant tanks. To optimize key parameters for the electromagnetic forming of curved workpieces, the effects of discharge voltage, coil inner diameter, and coil width on the forming results are studied.

pmc-12722859.title: Case Report: Post-LASIK exacerbation of granular corneal dystrophy type 2: a familial case with TGFBI mutation
pmc-12722859.creator: Longhao Kuang, Xuanjun Zhang, Yufang Wang, Qing Zhan, Jingjing Su, Baotao Lin, Ping Guo
pmc-12722859.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeTo demonstrate that LASIK is contraindicated in patients with granular corneal dystrophy through documentation of post-surgical disease exacerbation.MethodsComprehensive clinical evaluation including anterior segment photography and multimodal imaging were performed on the proband and affected family members. Genomic DNA was isolated from peripheral blood samples, and targeted sequence capture array technique followed by PCR and Sanger sequencing were employed for mutation identification.ResultsThe proband presented with bilateral progressive vision loss following LASIK surgery performed at age 18.

pmc-13091387.title: Comment on “Relevance of cerebral microbleeds with leaky blood brain barrier in traumatic brain injury and protective role of interferon-gamma: A cohort study”
pmc-13091387.creator: Sangameshwar Manikya, Varshini Vadhithala, Rajnish Kumar, Pankaj Nainwal
pmc-13091387.description: Highlights•Semi-quantitative Ktrans modeling may influence leaky CMB classification.•Absolute T1 mapping could improve BBB permeability accuracy.•Lesion location may outweigh lesion count for prognostic value.•Peripheral IFN-γ levels require longitudinal mechanistic validation.•Continuous BBB modeling may refine TBI biomarker stratification. pmc-13409603.title: Characterisation of Iron Content and Speciation in Australian Eggs
pmc-13409603.creator: Meg Willans, Gaewyn Ellison, Evelyn S. Innes, Jeremy L. Wykes, Pria Ramkissoon, Simon A. James, Mark J. Hackett, Natalie K. Morgan
pmc-13409603.description: The quantity and bioavailability of iron (Fe) in commercial chicken eggs have been subject to ongoing debate. Understanding the chemical form of Fe in eggs, and how different laying conditions or cooking environments may alter chemical form is important to guide future studies of Fe bioavailability.

pmc-13584449.creator: Kyung Hyun Oh, Jeungeun Seo, Yerin Yu, Fukushi Morishita, Alia Cynthia Luz, Huong Thi Giang Tran, Rajendra Prasad Hubraj Yadav, Martin P Grobusch, Hongjo Choi

pmc-13643478.title: Differential Effects of Antidepressants on Hypothalamic Serotonin Levels in Rats: An In Vivo Microdialysis Study
pmc-13643478.creator: Jae Heon Kim, Hyung Gun Kim, Miho Song, Chan Young Lee, Yun Seob Song
pmc-13643478.description: PurposeAntidepressants can induce urinary retention, difficulty in voiding, and delayed micturition, effects thought to result from detrusor relaxation and increased urethral sphincter tone mediated by enhanced central serotonergic activity. However, direct measurements of brain serotonin following antidepressant treatment remain limited. The relative risk of voiding difficulty across different antidepressant classes may help guide individualized antidepressant selection.
